info.name: MotorDigitalTwin.MotorElectroThermalMechanicalFaultable
info.description: Reduced-order WEG W22 5.5 kW electro-thermal-mechanical digital twin

equation: Rth_frame_ambient_K_W * max(1.0, f_rth_degradation) / max(0.1, 0.1 + 0.9 * cooling_flow_pu * max(0.05, f_cooling_eff))
if $outputAlias_T_winding_C >= 120.0 then 2 else if $outputAlias_T_winding_C >= 100.0 then 1 else 0
min(max($outputAlias_torque_load_Nm + B_friction_Nm_s * omega_ref + K_speed_Nm_s * (omega_ref - omega_mech), 0.0), max_torque_pu * T_rated_Nm)

if noEvent(max($outputAlias_torque_load_Nm + B_friction_Nm_s * omega_ref + K_speed_Nm_s * (omega_ref - omega_mech), 0.0) < max_torque_pu * T_rated_Nm) then if noEvent($outputAlias_torque_load_Nm + B_friction_Nm_s * omega_ref + K_speed_Nm_s * (omega_ref - omega_mech) > 0.0) then $torque_load_Nm_der + B_friction_Nm_s * $DER.omega_ref + K_speed_Nm_s * ($DER.omega_ref - $DER.omega_mech) else 0.0 else 0.0
if noEvent(0.0 > $outputAlias_torque_load_Nm * omega_mech) then 0.0 else $outputAlias_torque_load_Nm * $DER.omega_mech + $torque_load_Nm_der * omega_mech

0.5 * I_rated_A * (if noEvent(0.0 > $outputAlias_P_electrical_W * eta_rated / P_rated_W) then 0.0 else $P_electrical_W_der * eta_rated * P_rated_W / P_rated_W ^ 2.0) / sqrt(max(0.0, $outputAlias_P_electrical_W * eta_rated / P_rated_W))

4.0 * f_unbalance_severity * (2.0 * load_pu * max(omega_mech, 1.0) * (if noEvent(omega_mech > 1.0) then $DER.omega_mech else 0.0) / omega_rated_rad_s ^ 2.0 + $DER.load_pu * (max(omega_mech, 1.0) / omega_rated_rad_s) ^ 2.0)
if f_sensor_freeze then T_frozen_val - 273.15 + f_sensor_bias_C else $outputAlias_T_winding_C + f_sensor_bias_C
if T_winding_C >= 120.0 then 2 else if T_winding_C >= 100.0 then 1 else 0
if f_sensor_freeze then T_frozen_val - 273.15 + f_sensor_bias_C else T_winding_C + f_sensor_bias_C
if noEvent(0.0 > torque_load_Nm * omega_mech) then 0.0 else torque_load_Nm * der(omega_mech)
if noEvent(0.0 > P_shaft_W + P_loss_total_W) then 0.0 else $P_shaft_W_der

0.5 * I_rated_A * (if noEvent(0.0 > P_electrical_W * eta_rated / P_rated_W) then 0.0 else $P_electrical_W_der * eta_rated * P_rated_W / P_rated_W ^ 2.0) / sqrt(max(0.0, P_electrical_W * eta_rated / P_rated_W))

if noEvent($cse5 < max_torque_pu * T_rated_Nm) then if noEvent(torque_load_Nm + B_friction_Nm_s * omega_ref + K_speed_Nm_s * (omega_ref - omega_mech) > 0.0) then (-K_speed_Nm_s) * der(omega_mech) else 0.0 else 0.0
(P_fixed_loss + (T_winding - T_frame) / Rth_winding_frame_K_W + (273.15 + T_ambient_C - T_frame) / Rth_frame_ambient_actual) / C_frame_J_K
8.0 * f_unbalance_severity * load_pu * $cse1 * (if noEvent(omega_mech > 1.0) then der(omega_mech) else 0.0) / omega_rated_rad_s ^ 2.0
